provenance.notes: The repository was independently initialized and fetched only at the frozen pre-fix SHA. The supplied patch applied cleanly and its resulting blob prefixes match the patch headers. The solver commit object was not fetched; revision identity is verified by agreement among result.json, solution.md, and submission.md, plus the immutable patch and reconstructed tree evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.details: Both a positional parameter named help and an option bound to callback parameter help receive ordinary values. The synthetic --help option still prints help and exits 0.

tests.details: Focused regression: 2 passed, 90 deselected. Full practical suite: 1,896 passed, 24 skipped, 31,000 deselected, 1 xfailed, 0 failed.

regressions.details: Adversarial probes passed for repeated internal-name collisions (help, _help, __help), no-collision legacy naming, eager built-in help, and a user-owned public --help option. Full suite passed.

explainability.details: The patch is localized and the stated mechanism is consistent with the code: parser values use parameter names as keys, and the synthetic help option is assigned the first unused underscore-prefixed name.

prReadiness.details: Focused regression coverage, concise implementation comments, clean patch application, unchanged public help spelling, full tests, lint, formatting, and MyPy evidence are present.

build.details: uv sync --frozen --group tests succeeded, compileall succeeded for src/click and tests/test_commands.py, and uv build produced both an sdist and wheel.

lint.details: Ruff check and Ruff format --check passed on both changed files; git diff --check passed.

typecheck.details: Configured strict MyPy check passed with no issues in 26 source files. Current Pyright produced six errors and one warning on both pristine and patched trees, with no new diagnostic; this is recorded as baseline/tool-version drift, not a patch regression.

limitations: Python 3.12.14 on Linux only; no full interpreter matrix.
Stress-marked tests remain excluded by repository pytest configuration (31,000 deselections).
The solver commit object was not fetched because independent QA was restricted to the exact pre-fix source and supplied artifacts.
